title_template: {work_unit_id} — Validate controlled Human-by-Exception execution within existing authority
goal: Execute and validate one controlled Human-by-Exception control-plane transaction using only already-canonical authority, with exact provider/branch/PR/main readback and all owner, WAIT, STOP and separate-authority boundaries preserved.
scope: execute one controlled control-plane transaction only through an already-canonical delegated authority selected by existing execution admission
validate exact provider truth, selected work unit, branch, pull request and canonical main readback for the controlled transaction
validate CONTINUE_UNDER_EXISTING_AUTHORITY_ONLY without allowing the operationalizer itself to mutate state
validate OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED as owner-visible no-mutation no-replay behavior
validate WAIT_ONLY as no-mutation no-replay behavior
validate SEPARATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED and BLOCKED as fail-closed behavior
produce machine-verifiable evidence that no new authority is inferred or granted
forbidden_scope: create, infer or broaden provider-state, issue, branch, pull-request, merge, runtime, product, release, ruleset, ADWF or higher-autonomy authority
weaken exact Writer Lease, branch, pull-request, CI, provider-state or canonical-main binding requirements
weaken OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED, WAIT_ONLY, STOP_ONLY, SEPARATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED, BLOCKED or no-replay semantics
mutate product/runtime source or physical runtime
mutate ADWF binding/repository, release/tag/promotion, ruleset/security policy, PRIVATE evidence or 1080/1081 lifecycle
exit_criteria: one controlled existing-authority Human-by-Exception transaction has exact machine-verifiable precondition and readback evidence
automatic continuation remains limited to an explicit already-canonical delegated authority
OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED, WAIT_ONLY, STOP_ONLY, SEPARATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED and BLOCKED remain distinct fail-closed or no-mutation outcomes
operationalization execution grants no new mutation authority
exact-head hosted CI passes with no product/runtime, ADWF or 1080/1081 mutation
